evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A categorical distinction asserted as self-evident logic, performing rational persuasion through definitional contrast rather than evidence or authority.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Supplies a reframe that controls which facts matter — the substrate is commodity, the perspective is asset — combining informational control with a rational-persuasion argument from valuation logic.
